reply.shortGloss: to grab; to catch; to hold
reply.emotion: focused and firm, reaching out to secure something
notes: Use 잡다 when physically taking hold of an object with your hands, catching an animal or criminal, or even abstractly securing a date or a chance.

senses.definition: To take hold of something firmly with your hands.

examples.emotion: gentle and warm, feeling the small hand closing around yours

senses.definition: To intercept or take something that is moving in your hands.

examples.translation: The player caught the flying ball.
examples.emotion: quick and alert, reacting instantly to the moving object

senses.definition: To secure or fix a date, time, or plan.

examples.text: 우리는 다음 주에 만날 날짜를 잡았다.
examples.translation: We set a date to meet next week.
examples.emotion: satisfied and decisive, having finally agreed on a time
